messages:
Elaine (GTM): Quick sync — need final copy for the benchmark webinar and an updated battlecard vs cloud AI + infra vendors. Goal: webinar next Wed, handoff to sales by EOD Tue. Can folks share the latest claim bullets and lead-routing play? :raised_hands:
Riley (Content): Working on the narrative. Draft opener: 'Serving > owning' — focus on predictable latency/cost. Will post bullets by EOD today.
Marcus (Bench): Pushing a new slide with 99th perc latency and $/1M tokens for our configs vs CloudX and APIHub. Caveat: Cloud numbers are public configs; we tested with seq=256 sims. Uploading files to drive: https://drive.redwood/bench/18325
Priya (Sales Ops): Need explicit routing rules for demo-ready vs not. Proposed:
```
if lead.source == 'webinar' and lead.score >= 70 -> Route to AE (priority)
if lead.source == 'website' and lead.request == 'pricing' -> SDR
else -> nurture via marketing cadence
```
Jamal (Field): For battlecard, can we add short rebuttals for 'we already use CloudY managed models'? Suggested one-liners.
Riley (Content): Adding rebuttals. Example: 'You can switch serving without swapping your models — Redwood unifies runtime across hosted/dedicated/private.'
Marcus (Bench): Also adding a quick table for quantization and batch tradeoffs (latency vs cost) — helps sales call out levers.
Elaine (GTM): Good. @Priya can you map routing to AE queues (east/us vs west/eu) and handoff doc? Also @Riley include 2 customer-friendly bench callouts for the slide.
Priya (Sales Ops): On it. Routing notes: use tags: region, compliance_tier, urgency. Will drop a short CSV with queues by Tue AM.
Riley (Content): Draft slides + script uploaded: https://drive.redwood/marketing/webinar_18325/ — please review. Slide 7 is the 'cost vs latency' talking points.
Jamal (Field): Suggest a live demo showing failover: start host model then switch to quantized private for demo of graceful degradation.
Marcus (Bench): I'll prepare the test harness snippet for the demo. Paste below command to reproduce load:
```
python bench/run.py --model redwood-3b --seq 256 --qps 200 --quantize=int8
```
Elaine (GTM): Love it. Final asks: Riley finalize copy, Marcus finalize slides + demo snippet, Priya finalize routing CSV, Jamal prepare two objection scripts. Can we commit by Tue 5pm PT? :calendar:
All: :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: 'Webinar dry-run' Tue 09:00 PT — created.
Riley (Content): Confirmed, will run dry-run and share notes.
Priya (Sales Ops): Confirmed, routing CSV done by Tue 10:00 PT.
Marcus (Bench): Slides + harness by Mon EOD.
Jamal (Field): Objection scripts by Tue noon.
Elaine (GTM): Great work — will consolidate and send to sales leaders after dry-run. Thanks team! :rocket:
